body.purpose: Default UI text; chat prose may run at 1rem, 65-75ch measure.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and dropdowns; the depth ceiling.

shadows.name: input-hairline
shadows.purpose: Barely-there lift on inputs and outline buttons.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Saddle Ring keyboard focus; the loudest depth cue in the system.

motion.name: transition-standard
motion.purpose: Default for hover and state changes on controls.

motion.name: slide-up
motion.purpose: Entrance for toasts and surfaced content, 10px rise.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single call-to-action per view: Deep Forest fill, white label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #213c20; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(33, 60, 32, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(20 25% 33% / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions: Sage Mist fill with Forest Ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #d8dfd7; color: #2b391e; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(216, 223, 215, 0.8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(20 25% 33% / 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #f9f9f9; color: #202020; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #eae2e1; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03); cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #e8e8e8; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #644a40; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(20 25% 33% / 0.5); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Chrome-level quiet action; surfaces only on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: transparent; color: #202020; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #e8e8e8; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(20 25% 33% / 0.5); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Transparent field with Input Gray border; Saddle Ring focus.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 100%; min-width: 200px; padding: 4px 12px; background: transparent; color: #202020; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #d8d8d8; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03); outline: none; transition: color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #646464; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #644a40; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(20 25% 33% / 0.5); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Generously rounded (24px) container on Card White with whisper shadow.
components.html:
Workspace
One folder, all your files, sessions, and agent history in one place.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 24px; background: #fcfcfc; color: #202020; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #eae2e1; border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.10), 0 1px 2px -1px hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.10); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 14px; color: #646464; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Compact status marker; Deep Forest default.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; background: #213c20; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Skill Pill
components.description: Signature attach-a-skill chip: the one tinted use of Deep Forest, marking agent capability.
components.css: .ds-skill-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; background: rgba(33, 60, 32, 0.1); color: #213c20; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(33, 60, 32, 0.3); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-skill-pill-name { max-width: 200px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 500; background: none; border: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; } .ds-skill-pill-name:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-skill-pill-x { display: flex; height: 16px; width: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 4px; background: none; border: none; color: rgba(33, 60, 32, 0.6); cursor: pointer; padding: 0; } .ds-skill-pill-x:hover { background: rgba(33, 60, 32, 0.1); color: #213c20; }

narrative.overview: Cowork-Z looks and behaves like a competent co-worker: warm, plain-spoken, and calm while agents do real work on real files. The system is a light, quiet workspace — soft neutral surfaces, one deep green voice for action, and a single friendly typeface doing every job. Nothing performs. Trust comes from legibility: permissions, tool calls, and agent progress are always visible in the same steady visual language. The register is product. Familiarity is a feature; users should recognize every control from tools they already know (Notion's approachable surfaces, Claude Desktop's clean message stream).
keyCharacteristics: Light, soft-neutral canvas with one committed green accent
Single typeface (DM Sans) across all roles
Crisp and quiet components: tidy 6px control radii, generous 24px card radii, 150ms transitions
Whisper-level shadows; the focus ring is the loudest depth cue
Every state visible: hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Deep Forest speaks only for action and selection. It never decorates: no green section headers, no green icons for flavor, no green backgrounds behind passive content. Rarity is what makes the primary button read instantly.

rules.name: The State-Only Semantics Rule
rules.body: Tomato, Amber, and Meadow appear exclusively when the interface reports a state. A screen with no errors, warnings, or successes shows none of them.

rules.name: The Legacy Blue Ban
rules.body: accent.blue (#3397FC) exists for backward compatibility only. Prohibited in new work.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: DM Sans does every job. No display font, no second sans. Monospace appears only inside code blocks and file paths in agent output — never in UI chrome, labels, or navigation.

rules.name: The Whisper Rule
rules.body: If you notice the shadow, it is too dark. Depth beyond the overlay ceiling (25% alpha) is prohibited.

dos: Do route every color through the CSS variables in globals.css; components reference tokens (bg-primary, border-input), never raw hex.
Do give every interactive element the full state set: default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading, error.
Do keep body and muted text at AA contrast: Ink or Graphite on Canvas, nothing lighter than Graphite (#646464).
Do use skeletons for loading and empty states that teach the interface (empty-state.tsx exists — use it).
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion with a crossfade or instant alternative for every animation.
donts: Don't ship the "hacker terminal aesthetic" — no dark-mode-only screens, no monospace UI chrome, no matrix green.
Don't drift into "enterprise admin gray" — surfaces without the warm Clay Line borders and green accent become lifeless dashboard sprawl.
Don't import "SaaS marketing gloss" into the app: no gradient heroes, no glassmorphism, no gradient text anywhere.
Don't add "toy-like AI novelty": no sparkle emojis, mascots, or AI-magic theatrics around agent activity. Show the agent's hands instead.
Don't use the legacy blue (#3397FC) or hardcoded hex in new components.
Don't improvise dark-mode colors; dark tokens are undefined until they land in globals.css as a full set.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px) on cards, list items, or alerts.
Don't exceed the overlay shadow ceiling (25% alpha) or stack nested cards.
